subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should WebChat actively re-adopt in-flight runs from current Gateway history/session state on reconnect, or are the existing Stop visibility and queued-send mitigations sufficient for this issue?
rationale: Current source shows partial mitigation but not a complete WebChat active-run adoption contract, and the open candidate PR overlaps stale protocol/session-lifecycle decisions that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Implement WebChat in-flight run adoption
options.body: Use the existing `chat.history.inFlightRun` and filtered active-run helpers in WebChat, then require focused live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Rework the open candidate PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to rebase and narrow https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 against current protocol and session contracts with fresh proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigations only
options.body: Close or split remaining reports only if maintainers explicitly decide active-run re-adoption is outside the WebChat reconnect contract.

recommendation.title: Implement WebChat in-flight run adoption
recommendation.body: Use the existing `chat.history.inFlightRun` and filtered active-run helpers in WebChat, then require focused live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent native reconnect adoption and protocol-package history make this the best available owner for the cross-client recovery contract choice.
